title: Current State — Manual Anomaly Resolution, Per Cycle
subtitle: How a billing cycle is cleared today, before the workbench. The trust gap — where deciding whether a correction is safe costs more time than making it — is marked in red.
cycleTimeNote: Cycle times are labeled and illustrative.

steps.label: Pull billing, rate-card, tax and account reports
steps.detail: Four exports that were never designed to reconcile with each other
steps.system: Billing system, rate card, tax tables, account history

steps.label: Reconcile each anomaly by hand
steps.detail: Hours, and the sources disagree — every anomaly is a small investigation

steps.label: Real error, or a legitimate change?
steps.detail: The question that decides whether a customer gets a credit or a new dispute

steps.label: Correct one account at a time
steps.detail: Manual rebill per account; the volume never fits the window

steps.label: Escalate the unclear ones
steps.detail: A day lost per escalation, and it does not come back inside the cycle

steps.label: Rebill and hope it is right
steps.detail: No per-account confidence, no preview of the corrected amount

steps.label: 36-hour SLA met?
steps.detail: Often not — and the answer arrives after the window has closed

steps.label: Spillover into next cycle
steps.detail: Credits, adjustments, support calls, and an audit trail reconstructed after the fact

gapSummary: That is the trust gap: detection was never the hard part. Deciding whether a correction is safe — and being able to stand behind it afterwards — is what does not fit in 36 hours.

interventions.currentStep: Pull and reconcile four reports that disagree
interventions.intervention: Fuse every source into one cycle view and answer questions across all of them at once
interventions.impact: Hours of reconciliation removed before the first decision

interventions.intervention: Pre-group 207 anomalies into 6 patterns, each with a named root cause
interventions.impact: Investigation collapses from 207 items to 6 decisions

interventions.currentStep: Decide whether a correction is safe
interventions.intervention: Per-account confidence plus a current-versus-corrected reconciliation for every row
interventions.impact: Bulk action becomes defensible; fewer new disputes created by the fix

interventions.currentStep: Correct one account at a time
interventions.intervention: Apply Fix to All through the rebilling API, with a rebill ID and audit row per account
interventions.impact: 87 accounts corrected in one reviewed action, logged as it happens

interventions.currentStep: Find out downstream that it was late
interventions.intervention: Project calls prevented and hold time avoided against the remaining SLA
interventions.impact: Problems prevented inside the window rather than discovered next cycle
